description.description: Packs only: one line shown by `clingon pack`.

version.description: Packs only: bump it when the pack changes, e.g. 1.1.0.

default.description: Packs only: installed for new users.

requires.description: Packs only: commands `clingon doctor` checks are on PATH.

name.description: Shown in the top menu. Sections with the same name across files are merged.

icon.description: One glyph shown before the name: a symbol like ★ ◆ ⚙, or an emoji.

logo.description: A brand logo shown before the name instead of the icon, from clingon's font.

color.description: The icon's or logo's colour, like #ff5f5f. One of the 256 standard terminal colours looks the same in every terminal (others are rounded to the nearest). Grey if omitted.

category.description: Fixed heading the section is listed under on the main menu. Omitted means Other.

requires.description: The group is hidden unless all of these commands are on PATH.

when.description: when for every command in the group that doesn't set its own.

cmd.description: Shell command template. <name> is replaced by the arg called name.

desc.description: What the command does, in a sentence. Shown in the Description area, and extended by each arg's desc as you fill them in.

risk.description: warn: marked ⚠ and asks No/Yes before running. Use it for anything that changes or stops things but can be put right: merges, rebases, pushes, stopping or restarting, uninstalling, overwriting files you can make again, changing shared state. danger: marked ☠ in red; you type a random 4-letter code, then it asks No/Yes. Use it for anything that destroys data or shared state for good: deleting files or uncommitted work, hard resets, deleting remote branches, removing containers or volumes, overwriting a bucket, terraform apply, dropping, restoring or dumping databases.

when.description: Greyed out unless one of these files (globs allowed, e.g. *.tf) is in the shell's folder or a folder above it (start with ./ for this folder only), e.g. [.git] or [package.json].

requires.description: The command is hidden unless all of these are on PATH.

type.description: Inferred when omitted: options → choose, otherwise text.

prompt.description: Label shown when asking; defaults to name.

desc.description: A sentence added to the command's description once this arg is filled. <name> is replaced by the value, e.g. "From <container>."

default.description: Value used unless changed. For flags, the options ticked to begin with, joined by the separator.

join.description: Separator for flags; default is a space.

quote.description: Shell-quote the value, for free text that may contain spaces or quotes.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole typed value must match, e.g. [0-9]+ for a port.
